senses.gloss: f. (v. אוֹן) possession, title of possession, deed.
units: Gen. R. s. 79 (ref. to the letters יה in קשיֹטהֹ Gen. XXXIII, 19) יו״ד ה״א כותב הא׳ וכ׳ Yod He (i.e. the Lord) writes the deed; the Lord bears witness to the deed.—Pl. אוֹנוֹת.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 52a:8">B. Bath. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ ושטרות וכ׳</he> deeds of purchase and other documents were issued in his name.
